annotations.title: Pickleball Court Cost and Size Planner

description: Use this when asked 'How much space do I need for a backyard pickleball court and will it fit?' or 'What have public pickleball court projects cost per court?' Returns rulebook footprints and one-court fit in either orientation, separate cost cards, and unpriced scope. Cost cards are public city project and planning figures, not a price for this court. Pure rules and Decimal, no network, model or clock. Web and MCP share the free daily allowance. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

courts.description: Court count; omitted uses 1 for math, marked assumed.

space_length_ft.description: Open, level space in feet; provide both length and width or neither.
